angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) and pass-rush-drill get-off burst vs NFL get-off and pressure rate; year-standardized; yardstick = no-tracking forecast (pick, weight, EDGE share, NGS score, official 10-yd split and 3-cone) fit leave-one-class-out; used as a day-3/undrafted tiebreaker
metric_name: Hoop G: hardest 0.5 s of sideways acceleration (g) on the Run-the-Hoop lap, z within Combine year; shortlist = day-3/undrafted AND top third of class
headline_number: Day-3/undrafted shortlist beat its out-of-class no-tracking pressure forecast 8 of 15 vs 8 of 32 (gap +28 points, 90% 4 to 50; time-forward +20, selection-reweighted +18, both crossing zero). Across all 15 matched boards the shortlisted player was ahead 8 times (53%, 90% 26 to 81, peer-clustered). Drill burst to pressure rho 0.06 (-0.14 to 0.26).
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 15 cand_1 (8.11) applying the round-15 judges' transferable top_changes: (1) one number per claim - drill burst to pressure is now only the rho shown in Fig 4 (the separate points-per-sd slope removed), Hoop G to pressure stated once (slope, Fig 3), all 'earlier rounds'/'round 13' references deleted; (2) analyst machinery (selection model, Mantel-Haenszel, Bayesian, relabelling, ridge, drop-best) moved to the appendix, new plain-language 'Why pass rushers, why now' section and a one-sentence Hoop G definition; (3) hand-picked Johnson/Kennard worked boards replaced by all 15 matched boards (new Fig 5) with a peer-clustered bootstrap, the illustration chosen by rule (board nearest the median), and a pre-registered 2026 test: frozen_rule.json + frozen_shortlist.json SHA-256 prefix in the text, one-sided Fisher at 10%, simulated power for 1/2/3 classes; (4) 2025 shortlist rebuilt for use: action tiers (act: widen role / camp audition; watch; hold) with the 3 act-on names in the lede, availability = 2025 games + roster status (reserve list flagged), role note = EDGE share + lateral-rush share from sampled tracking, and the rule's 2023-24 hit/miss history by name; (5) viz: Fig 1B per-class slices greyed as low power with pooled emphasis and base-rate line, Fig 3 legend outside the data, IQR band of regulars, faded low-power rushers, larger fonts throughout, Fig 2 colorbar marks the median Hoop G. 1,985 words by check.py, 5 figures + 4 tables.
open_risks: The rule was chosen after seeing 2023-24 data (best of 14 screened drill-outcome pairs, search-adjusted p 0.10); the pre-registered 2026 test has only about 26% power alone and 63% over three classes.
The stricter versions (time-forward +20, selection-reweighted +18) have intervals crossing zero; matched boards are 8 of 15 with a 26-81% interval, a near coin flip per decision.
Small counts (15 vs 32), Hoop G reliability from 10 linemen with two runs (0.37); only 8 distinct peers across the 15 boards.
No visible in-game mechanism for Hoop G (first-second burst 0.07, 1.5 s depth 0.04); no blockers, no injury data - availability only from games played and a single roster-status snapshot.
Act-on list includes two players on a reserve list (Brinson, Downs); the action tiers (e.g. +2 sd audition cut) are judgement calls, not fit.
